headline: Oil Falls 3.39 Percent To $100.59 As The S&P 500 Drops 1.82 Percent
narrative: Crude oil fell 3.39 percent to $100.59, money leaving the energy pipe. The S&P 500 fell 1.82 percent to 7,580.07, the equity pipe selling with energy, while silver rose 2.12 percent to $50.14, a bid in the precious-metals pipe. Gold rose 0.42 percent to $3,915.4 and copper rose 0.79 percent to $6.51, so the metals pipes took the bid the oil market gave up.
author: jordan
